subject.title: fix(cli): reject --channel/--to for systemEvent cron jobs with a clear error

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally change previously accepted-but-ignored main-session chat-delivery flags into errors, and require the same behavior from both `cron add` and `cron edit`?
rationale: The fail-fast behavior prevents silently lost delivery intent, but it changes a public CLI contract and existing automation may begin failing rather than creating a job.

options.title: Reject consistently
options.body: Adopt the fail-fast contract for both add and edit, with focused tests for main, isolated, implicit-channel, and webhook cases.

options.title: Keep add-only rejection
options.body: Merge the narrower behavior while explicitly accepting that edit can continue silently discarding the same options.

options.title: Preserve compatibility
options.body: Keep accepting the flags and instead emit an actionable warning without failing existing automation.

recommendation.title: Reject consistently
recommendation.body: Adopt the fail-fast contract for both add and edit, with focused tests for main, isolated, implicit-channel, and webhook cases.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent history most strongly connects this person to cron CLI delivery validation and the supporting service behavior.
